verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai that indexes the API docs. Every docs page is also served as markdown (.md) with a pointer back to the llms.txt index, and a machine-readable openapi.json is published, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing how agents should consume these files, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
